properties.warning: Not a dig-here layer. Recheck current tenure and conditions before travel.

properties.legal_gate: Desktop validation point only. Confirm the current GPA boundary, live tenure, posted signs, closures, hazards and exact-ground conditions on the day. Move or abandon the point if any gate fails.
properties.method_note: Coarse interior point selected by a 45 by 45 polygon grid to maximise distance from the target edge. It is not a gold coordinate or access guarantee.
